professional [[basketball]] player. He played [[college basketball]] for [[Oakland Golden Grizzlies men's basketball|Oakland University]]. A 6-foot-11 [[center (basketball)|center]], Benson was a second-round pick (48th overall) in the [[2011 NBA draft]], selected by the [[Atlanta Hawks]]. He has since played in Italy, Philippines, Belarus, China, Lithuania, Estonia and the NBA Development League. ==High school career== Born in [[Cleveland, Ohio]] and raised in [[Farmington Hills, Michigan]], Benson attended [[Detroit Country Day School]] in [[Beverly Hills, Michigan]].{{cite web |title=Keith Benson |url=https://www.basketball-reference.com/players/b/bensoke02.html |work=basketball-reference.com |access-date=March 8, 2013}} On the Detroit Country Day basketball team, Benson averaged only 6.9 points and 4.5 rebounds per game as a senior.{{cite web|last=Young |first=Justin |title=Summit Preseason Player of the Year: Keith Benson |url=https://nationalhoopsreport.blogspot.com/2009/11/summit-preseason-player-of-year-keith.html |access-date=June 24, 2011 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110708054509/http://nationalhoopsreport.blogspot.com/2009/11/summit-preseason-player-of-year-keith.html |archive-date=July 8, 2011 |date=November 7, 2009 |url-status=dead }} Benson initially committed to [[Fairfield Stags men's basketball|Fairfield]], but changed his mind after a coaching change and committed to Oakland after they offered him a scholarship.{{cite web|last=Kampe |first=Paul |title=MEN'S BASKETBALL: Dedication makes Keith Benson a pillar of Oakland hoops |url=http://www.theoaklandpress.com/articles/2011/01/22/sports/grizzlies/doc4d3b2b0eee35a704980158.txt?viewmode=fullstory |publisher=The Oakland Press |access-date=June 24, 2011 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120728121242/http://www.theoaklandpress.com/articles/2011/01/22/sports/grizzlies/doc4d3b2b0eee35a704980158.txt?viewmode=fullstory |archive-date=July 28, 2012 |date=January 22, 2011 |url-status=dead }} ==College career== After [[Redshirt (college sports)|redshirt]]ing his first year at Oakland, Benson became a starter for the [[2007–08 Oakland Golden Grizzlies men's basketball team|2007–08 season]]. Benson started 20 of the team's 29 games and averaged 5.2 points and 3.5 rebounds.{{cite web|title=Oakland Basketball Individual Career History BENSON, Keith |url=http://grfx.cstv.com/photos/schools/oakl/sports/m-baskbl/auto_pdf/Benson_career.pdf |publisher=Oakland University |access-date=June 24, 2011 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110708121254/http://grfx.cstv.com/photos/schools/oakl/sports/m-baskbl/auto_pdf/Benson_career.pdf |archive-date=July 8, 2011 |page=1 |url-status=dead }} He finished the season with 40 blocks—one shy of Oakland's single-season record.{{cite web|last=Pemberton |first=Doug |title=Hard work pays off for OU's Benson |url=http://www.theoaklandpress.com/articles/2009/02/21/sports/doc499ffdb193084600376038.txt |publisher=Oakland Press |access-date=June 24, 2011 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120228201535/http://www.theoaklandpress.com/articles/2009/02/21/sports/doc499ffdb193084600376038.txt |archive-date=February 28, 2012 |date=February 21, 2009 |url-status=dead }} However, he was benched prior to the conference tournament because OU's head coach, [[Greg Kampe]], felt Benson was not playing good enough defense. At the conclusion of his redshirt junior season, Benson received the [[Lou Henson Award]], given to the "mid-major player of the year".{{cite web|title=Benson Receives Lou Henson Award as Mid-Major Player of the Year |url=http://www.thesummitleague.org//ViewArticle.dbml?DB_OEM_ID=3900&ATCLID=204920562 |publisher=The Summit League |date=April 2, 2010 |access-date=October 24, 2015 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120304220906/http://www.thesummitleague.org//ViewArticle.dbml?DB_OEM_ID=3900&ATCLID=204920562 |archive-date=March 4, 2012 }} Benson was also named the Summit League Player of the Year.{{cite web |title=Men's Basketball Media Guide |url=http://www.thesummitleague.org/fls/3900/sports/mbball/mediaguides/2010-11/Review%20Section_42-57.pdf?DB_OEM_ID=3900 |publisher=The Summit League |access-date=June 24, 2011 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20111001075628/http://www.thesummitleague.org/fls/3900/sports/mbball/mediaguides/2010-11/Review%20Section_42-57.pdf?DB_OEM_ID=3900 |archive-date=October 1, 2011 |url-status=dead }} Benson declared himself eligible for the [[2010 NBA draft]],{{cite web |url=http://www.freep.com/article/20100415/SPORTS08/100415076/1356/sports/Oaklands-Keith-Benson-enters-NBA-draft |title=Oakland's Keith Benson enters NBA draft |date=April 15, 2010 |first=Mark |last=Snyder |access-date=April 23, 2014|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20100430063155/http://www.freep.com/article/20100415/SPORTS08/100415076/1356/SPORTS/Oaklands-Keith-Benson-enters-NBA-draft|archive-date=April 30, 2010}} but withdrew himself after he was unable to work out with NBA teams due to an injured right thumb.
